items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Then you went with Dr. Robert. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I worked pretty hard on the instrument.

ctx.x: Well, during, I might say during the war, you know, around, between 1940, 70. I see, it was really early.
Yeah. Then you went with Dr. Robert.

Yeah, I worked pretty hard on the instrument. See, it might sound like I was making plenty of headway to you, but I was working like a dog to do it too. I was working day, I had a day job, and I was trying to do both, and I had to concentrate plenty on the trumpet, you know, in evenings from work, and all times I had on.
